steps.name: 01 Home
steps.goal: Be on the home session list with the composer visible
steps.done: Home is showing and the composer can dictate a message

steps.name: 02 Folders sheet
steps.goal: Open the folder arrangement sheet. Long-press a folder pill on the home rail, or use the folders control that opens the same sheet.
steps.done: The Folders sheet is open and lists at least one project folder

steps.name: 03 Deploy row
steps.goal: Find the Deploy control on a folder row. Do not tap it. Confirm the row can publish that folder.
steps.done: A Deploy or Redeploy control is visible on a folder row
